verses.sloka: स सागरमनाधृष्यमतिक्रम्य महाबलः ।त्रिकूटशिखरे लङ्कां स्थितां स्वस्थो ददर्श ह ॥५-२-१॥
verses.transliteration: sa sāgaramanādhṛṣyamatikramya mahābalaḥ ।trikūṭaśikhare laṅkāṁ sthitāṁ svastho dadarśa ha ॥5-2-1॥

translations.english: The mighty Hanuman crossed the inviolable sea, stood comfortably on the peak of Trikuta mountain and looked at Lanka.

verses.sloka: ततः पादपमुक्तेन पुष्पवर्षेण वीर्यवान् ।अभिवृष्टः स्थितस्तत्र बभौ पुष्पमयो यथा ॥५-२-२॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pādapamuktena puṣpavarṣeṇa vīryavān ।abhivṛṣṭaḥ sthitastatra babhau puṣpamayo yathā ॥5-2-2॥

translations.english: Covered fully with the continuous shower of flowers dropped on him from the trees, heroic Hanuman appeared as though he was a heap of flowers as he stood there.

verses.sloka: योजनानां शतं श्रीमांस्तीर्त्वाप्युत्तमविक्रमः ।अनिःस्वसन् कपिस्तत्र न ग्लानिमधिगच्छति ॥५-२-३॥
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṁ śataṁ śrīmāṁstīrtvāpyuttamavikramaḥ ।aniḥsvasan kapistatra na glānimadhigacchati ॥5-2-3॥

translations.english: The glorious, powerful vanara (Hanuman) even after crossing a hundred yojanas, felt neither suffocated nor exasperated.

verses.sloka: शतान्यहं योजनानां क्रमेयं सुबहुन्यपि ।किं पुनः सागरस्यान्तं संख्यातं शतयोजनम् ॥५-२-४॥
verses.transliteration: śatānyahaṁ yojanānāṁ krameyaṁ subahunyapi ।kiṁ punaḥ sāgarasyāntaṁ saṁkhyātaṁ śatayojanam ॥5-2-4॥

translations.english: (He said to himself), "I can cross a distance of even hundreds of yojanas. What to say of a hundred yojanas which is a calculated distance."
translations.hindi: नोट-एक इतिहास में लिखा है कि हनुमानजी तैर कर लंका में पहुंचे थे श्रौर बीच बीच में टापुओं पर ठहर दम लेते थे । इन लोगों को इस इलोक के “निःश्वसन्‌” शब्द पर ध्यान देना चाहिए । ] शतान्यहं योजनानां क्रमेयं सुबहून्यपि । कि पुनः सागरस्यान्तं संख्यातं शतयोजनम्‌

verses.sloka: स तु वीर्यवतां श्रेष्ठः प्लवतामपि चोत्तमः ।जगाम वेगवान् लङ्कां लङ्घयित्वा महोदधिम् ॥५-२-५॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu vīryavatāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ plavatāmapi cottamaḥ ।jagāma vegavān laṅkāṁ laṅghayitvā mahodadhim ॥5-2-5॥

translations.english: Courageous and exalted Hanuman, the best among vanaras, noted for his speed reached Lanka crossing over the great ocean on his own.
translations.hindi: जब पवननन्दन हनुमानजी ने उस पहाड़ पर खड़े होकर देखा, तब उन्हें वन, उपवन तथा पर्वतशिखर पर बसी हुई लंका देख पड़ी

verses.sloka: शाद्वलानि च नीलानि गन्धवन्ति वनानि च ।गण्डवन्ति च मध्येन जगाम नगवन्ति च ॥५-२-६॥
verses.transliteration: śādvalāni ca nīlāni gandhavanti vanāni ca ।gaṇḍavanti ca madhyena jagāma nagavanti ca ॥5-2-6॥

translations.english: Hanuman passed through forests laden with fragrant flowers, bluish grassy land, big rocks and mountains covered with trees.
translations.hindi: Ol टु पाठान्तरे -“तरुसड्खनान ज्छभात, Pe cc-8. दाना रा गव, BB An 6००8 । 32 वानरोत्तम तेजस्वी हनुमानजी, रास्ते में हरी-हरी घासों आर सुगन्घ- युक्त मधु से शोभित वनों और वृक्षों से भरे और सुन्दर वृक्षों से श्राच्छादित पव॑तों भ्रौर पुष्पित वृक्षों से वनों में हो कर जा रहे थे

verses.sloka: शैलांश्च तरुसंचन्नान् वनराजीश्च पुष्पिताः ।अभिचक्राम तेजस्वी हनुमान् प्लवगर्षभः ॥५-२-७॥
verses.transliteration: śailāṁśca tarusaṁcannān vanarājīśca puṣpitāḥ ।abhicakrāma tejasvī hanumān plavagarṣabhaḥ ॥5-2-7॥

translations.english: Brilliant Hanuman, a bull among monkeys, crossed the mountains covered with blossoming trees and forest ranges.

verses.sloka: स तस्मिन्नचले तिष्ठन्वनान्युपवनानि च ।स नगाग्रे च तां लङ्कां ददर्श पवनात्मजः ॥५-२-८॥
verses.transliteration: sa tasminnacale tiṣṭhanvanānyupavanāni ca ।sa nagāgre ca tāṁ laṅkāṁ dadarśa pavanātmajaḥ ॥5-2-8॥

translations.english: That son of the Windgod stood on the mountain and saw the forests and groves round Lanka situated on the mountain peak.

verses.sloka: सरLआन् कर्णिकारांश्च खर्जूरांश्च सुपुष्पितान् ।प्रियाLआन्मुचुLइन्दांश्च कुटजान् केतकानपि ॥५-२-९॥
verses.transliteration: saraLān karṇikārāṁśca kharjūrāṁśca supuṣpitān ।priyāLānmucuLindāṁśca kuṭajān ketakānapi ॥5-2-9॥

translations.english: The mighty vanara saw around Lanka, trees like sarala, karnikara in full bloom, datepalms, priyala, muchulinda, kutaja, kethaka trees filled with fragrance priyangu, kadamba, so also flowering plants like saptachhada, asana, kovidara and karaveera fully loaded with flowers and buds. These trees were thronged by birds, with their branches shaken by the wind. Flocks of swans and waterfowls were found in ponds of different types. There were various pleasure groves with flowers in bloom and fruits of all seasons and varieties of water resorts and delightful gardens.

verses.sloka: प्रियङ्गून् गन्धपूर्णांश्च नीपान् सप्तच्छदांस्तथा ।असनान् कोविदारांश्च करवीरांश्च पुष्पितान् ॥५-२-१०॥
verses.transliteration: priyaṅgūn gandhapūrṇāṁśca nīpān saptacchadāṁstathā ।asanān kovidārāṁśca karavīrāṁśca puṣpitān ॥5-2-10॥

translations.english: The mighty vanara saw around Lanka, trees like sarala, karnikara in full bloom, datepalms, priyala, muchulinda, kutaja, kethaka trees filled with fragrance priyangu, kadamba, so also flowering plants like saptachhada, asana, kovidara and karaveera fully loaded with flowers and buds. These trees were thronged by birds, with their branches shaken by the wind. Flocks of swans and waterfowls were found in ponds of different types. There were various pleasure groves with flowers in bloom and fruits of all seasons and varieties of water resorts and delightful gardens.
translations.hindi: सुगन्धित प्रियंगु, कदंब, शतावरी, असन, कोविदार ग्रौर फूले हुए करवीर “के वृक्ष देख पड़े

verses.sloka: पुष्पभारनिबद्धांश्च तथा मुकुLइतानपि ।पादपान् विहगाकीर्णान् पवनाधूतमस्तकान् ॥५-२-११॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpabhāranibaddhāṁśca tathā mukuLitānapi ।pādapān vihagākīrṇān pavanādhūtamastakān ॥5-2-11॥

translations.english: The mighty vanara saw around Lanka, trees like sarala, karnikara in full bloom, datepalms, priyala, muchulinda, kutaja, kethaka trees filled with fragrance priyangu, kadamba, so also flowering plants like saptachhada, asana, kovidara and karaveera fully loaded with flowers and buds. These trees were thronged by birds, with their branches shaken by the wind. Flocks of swans and waterfowls were found in ponds of different types. There were various pleasure groves with flowers in bloom and fruits of all seasons and varieties of water resorts and delightful gardens.
translations.hindi: इन वृक्षों में से बहुत से तो फूलों से लदे हुए थे और बहुत एसे भी थे जिनमें कलियां लगी हुई थीं । उन पर झु ड के झु ड पक्षी बैठे हुए थे । उन वुक्षो की फूनगियां पवन के चलने से हिल रही थीं

verses.sloka: हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णान्वापीः पद्मोत्मलायुताः ।आक्रीडान् विविधान् रम्यान्विविधांश्च जलाशयान् ॥५-२-१२॥
verses.transliteration: haṁsakāraṇḍavākīrṇānvāpīḥ padmotmalāyutāḥ ।ākrīḍān vividhān ramyānvividhāṁśca jalāśayān ॥5-2-12॥

translations.english: The mighty vanara saw around Lanka, trees like sarala, karnikara in full bloom, datepalms, priyala, muchulinda, kutaja, kethaka trees filled with fragrance priyangu, kadamba, so also flowering plants like saptachhada, asana, kovidara and karaveera fully loaded with flowers and buds. These trees were thronged by birds, with their branches shaken by the wind. Flocks of swans and waterfowls were found in ponds of different types. There were various pleasure groves with flowers in bloom and fruits of all seasons and varieties of water resorts and delightful gardens.
translations.hindi: वहाँ बावलियाँ भी थीं, जिनमें हंस ओर जलमुगं खेल रहे थे श्रौर कमल तथा कुई फूल रहे थे वहाँ पर विहार करने योग्य तरह-तरह की रमणीक बाटिकाएं थीं, जिनके भीतर विविध आकार प्रकार के जलकुण्ड बने हुए से

verses.sloka: संततान् विविधैर्वऋकैः सर्वर्तुफलपुष्पितैः ।उद्यानानि च रम्याणि ददर्श कपिकुञ्जरः ॥५-२-१३॥
verses.transliteration: saṁtatān vividhairvaṛkaiḥ sarvartuphalapuṣpitaiḥ ।udyānāni ca ramyāṇi dadarśa kapikuñjaraḥ ॥5-2-13॥

translations.english: The mighty vanara saw around Lanka, trees like sarala, karnikara in full bloom, datepalms, priyala, muchulinda, kutaja, kethaka trees filled with fragrance priyangu, kadamba, so also flowering plants like saptachhada, asana, kovidara and karaveera fully loaded with flowers and buds. These trees were thronged by birds, with their branches shaken by the wind. Flocks of swans and waterfowls were found in ponds of different types. There were various pleasure groves with flowers in bloom and fruits of all seasons and varieties of water resorts and delightful gardens.
translations.hindi: सब ऋतुं में फलने फूलने वाले भ्रनेक प्रकार के वृक्षों से युक्त, वहाँ रमणीक वाटिकाएँ भो हनुमानजी ने देखीं

verses.sloka: समासाद्य च लक्ष्मीवन् लङ्कां रावणपालिताम् ।परिखाभिः सपद्माभिः सोत्पलाभिरलंकृताम् ॥५-२-१४॥
verses.transliteration: samāsādya ca lakṣmīvan laṅkāṁ rāvaṇapālitām ।parikhābhiḥ sapadmābhiḥ sotpalābhiralaṁkṛtām ॥5-2-14॥

translations.english: Fortunate Hanuman having reached Lanka ruled by Ravana found it surrounded by moats full of blue lotuses, guarded by demons with frightening bows, in view of Sita abducted and kept there. It was protected by boundary walls inlaid with gold that great and beautiful city with buildings resembling the assembly of planets and whitewashed, elevated houses looking like autumnal clouds and well laid out streets decorated with garlands of banners and flag posts, rows of colourful creepers and festoons. The city of Lanka appeared like Amaravati, the city of gods.
translations.hindi: शोभायुक्त हनुमान जी श्रव रावणपालित लंका के समीप पहुँचे । लंकापुरी फूले कमलो तथा कुई से युक्त, परिखा से घिरी हुई थी

verses.sloka: सीतापहरणार्थेन रावणेन सुरक्षिताम् ।समन्ताद्विचरद्भिश्च राक्षसैरुग्रधन्विभिः ॥५-२-१५॥
verses.transliteration: sītāpaharaṇārthena rāvaṇena surakṣitām ।samantādvicaradbhiśca rākṣasairugradhanvibhiḥ ॥5-2-15॥

translations.english: Fortunate Hanuman having reached Lanka ruled by Ravana found it surrounded by moats full of blue lotuses, guarded by demons with frightening bows, in view of Sita abducted and kept there. It was protected by boundary walls inlaid with gold that great and beautiful city with buildings resembling the assembly of planets and whitewashed, elevated houses looking like autumnal clouds and well laid out streets decorated with garlands of banners and flag posts, rows of colourful creepers and festoons. The city of Lanka appeared like Amaravati, the city of gods.
translations.hindi: जब से रावण सीता को हर कर लाया था, तब से लंका की विशेष रूप से निगरानी करने के लिए कामरूपी राक्षस लंका के चारों ओर घूम कर पहरा दिया करते थे । ( हनुमान जी ने इन पहरुए राक्षसों को भी देखा)

verses.sloka: काञ्चनेनावृतां रम्यां प्राकारेण महापुरीम् ।गृहैश्च ग्रहसंकाशैः शारदाम्बुदसन्निभैः ॥५-२-१६॥
verses.transliteration: kāñcanenāvṛtāṁ ramyāṁ prākāreṇa mahāpurīm ।gṛhaiśca grahasaṁkāśaiḥ śāradāmbudasannibhaiḥ ॥5-2-16॥

translations.english: Fortunate Hanuman having reached Lanka ruled by Ravana found it surrounded by moats full of blue lotuses, guarded by demons with frightening bows, in view of Sita abducted and kept there. It was protected by boundary walls inlaid with gold that great and beautiful city with buildings resembling the assembly of planets and whitewashed, elevated houses looking like autumnal clouds and well laid out streets decorated with garlands of banners and flag posts, rows of colourful creepers and festoons. The city of Lanka appeared like Amaravati, the city of gods.
translations.hindi: लंकापुरी के चारों ग्रोर बड़ा सुन्दर सोने का परकोटा खिंचा हुआ था । उसके भौतर शरत्कालीन मेघों के समान सफेद श्रौर पहाड़ों की तरह ऊंचे-ऊंचे प्रनेक मकान बने हुए थे

verses.sloka: पाण्डुराभिः प्रतोLईभिरुच्चाभिरभिसंवृताम् ।अट्टालकशताकीर्णां पताकाध्वजमालिनीम् ॥५-२-१७॥
verses.transliteration: pāṇḍurābhiḥ pratoLībhiruccābhirabhisaṁvṛtām ।aṭṭālakaśatākīrṇāṁ patākādhvajamālinīm ॥5-2-17॥

translations.english: Fortunate Hanuman having reached Lanka ruled by Ravana found it surrounded by moats full of blue lotuses, guarded by demons with frightening bows, in view of Sita abducted and kept there. It was protected by boundary walls inlaid with gold that great and beautiful city with buildings resembling the assembly of planets and whitewashed, elevated houses looking like autumnal clouds and well laid out streets decorated with garlands of banners and flag posts, rows of colourful creepers and festoons. The city of Lanka appeared like Amaravati, the city of gods.
translations.hindi: लंका में सफेद गच की हुई पक्की श्रौर साफ सुथरी गलियाँ थीं। सैकड़ों भ्रटारियोंदार मकान थे श्रौर जगह-जगह ध्वजा पताकाएँ फहराते हुए देखा

verses.sloka: तोरणैः काञ्चनैर्दिव्यैर्लतापङ्किविचित्रितैः ।ददर्श हनुमान् लङ्कां दिवि देवपुरीं यथा ॥५-२-१८॥
verses.transliteration: toraṇaiḥ kāñcanairdivyairlatāpaṅkivicitritaiḥ ।dadarśa hanumān laṅkāṁ divi devapurīṁ yathā ॥5-2-18॥

translations.english: Fortunate Hanuman having reached Lanka ruled by Ravana found it surrounded by moats full of blue lotuses, guarded by demons with frightening bows, in view of Sita abducted and kept there. It was protected by boundary walls inlaid with gold that great and beautiful city with buildings resembling the assembly of planets and whitewashed, elevated houses looking like autumnal clouds and well laid out streets decorated with garlands of banners and flag posts, rows of colourful creepers and festoons. The city of Lanka appeared like Amaravati, the city of gods.

verses.sloka: गिरिमूर्ध्नि स्थितां लङ्कां पाण्डुरैर्भवनैः शुभैः ।ददर्श स कपिश्रेष्ठः पुरमाकाशगं यथा ॥५-२-१९॥
verses.transliteration: girimūrdhni sthitāṁ laṅkāṁ pāṇḍurairbhavanaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।dadarśa sa kapiśreṣṭhaḥ puramākāśagaṁ yathā ॥5-2-19॥

translations.english: The foremost among the vanaras, perched on top of the mountain saw the city of Lanka on the mountain with auspicious mansions as though touching the sky.

verses.sloka: पालितां राक्षसेन्द्रेण निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा ।प्लवमानामिवाकाशे ददर्श हनुमान् पुरीम् ॥५-२-२०॥
verses.transliteration: pālitāṁ rākṣasendreṇa nirmitāṁ viśvakarmaṇā ।plavamānāmivākāśe dadarśa hanumān purīm ॥5-2-20॥

translations.english: The city of Lanka, ruled by the lord of demons and built by Visvakarma looked as if it was a city floating in the sky.
translations.hindi: लंकापुरी का शासन रावण के हाथ में था और विश्‍वकर्मा ने इस पुरी को बनाया था । हनुमानजी ने देखा कि, उसके भीतर जो ऊंचे-ऊंच अवन खड़े थे, उनको देखने से ऐसा जान पड़ता था मानों वह पुरी श्राकाश में उड़ी जा रही हो

verses.sloka: पप्रप्राकारजघनां विपुलाम्बुनवाम्बराम् ।शतघ्नीशूलकेशान्तामट्टालकवतंसकाम् ॥५-२-२१॥
verses.transliteration: papraprākārajaghanāṁ vipulāmbunavāmbarām ।śataghnīśūlakeśāntāmaṭṭālakavataṁsakām ॥5-2-21॥

translations.english: Having reached the northern entrance of the city he started thinking that Visvakarma must have conceived Lanka as a lady with its ramparts as her hips and loins, moats filled with water as her robes, the spiked iron tridents as her locks of hair, and the tall towers as her her ear rings
translations.hindi: लंका की परकोटे की दीवालं तो लंकारूपिणी स्त्री की मानों जाँच हैं, उसके चारों ओर जो वन आर समुद्र था, वह मानों उसके पहिनने के वस्त्र थे । शतघ्नी [ तोपें ] और त्रिशूल मानों उसके मस्तक के वेश थे और उसकी जो अटारियाँ थीं, वे मानों उसके कानों के कर्णफूल थे

verses.sloka: मन्सेव कृतां लङ्कां निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा ।द्वारमुत्तरमासाद्य चिन्तयामास वानरः ॥५-२-२२॥
verses.transliteration: manseva kṛtāṁ laṅkāṁ nirmitāṁ viśvakarmaṇā ।dvāramuttaramāsādya cintayāmāsa vānaraḥ ॥5-2-22॥

translations.english: Having reached the northern entrance of the city he started thinking that Visvakarma must have conceived Lanka as a lady with its ramparts as her hips and loins, moats filled with water as her robes, the spiked iron tridents as her locks of hair, and the tall towers as her her ear rings
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार की लंकापुरी को विश्वकर्मा ने बड़े मन से श्रर्थात्‌ जी लगा कर बनाया था। जब हनुमानजी लंका के उत्तर दिशा वाले फाटक पर पहुँचे, तब चे मन ही मन कहने लगे

verses.sloka: कैलासशिखरप्रख्यामालिख्स्न्तीमिवाम्बरम् ।डीयमानामिवाकाशमुच्छ्रितैर्भवनोत्तमैः ॥५-२-२३॥
verses.transliteration: kailāsaśikharaprakhyāmālikhsntīmivāmbaram ।ḍīyamānāmivākāśamucchritairbhavanottamaiḥ ॥5-2-23॥

translations.english: Observing Lanka that resembled mount Kailas, with sky scrapers appearing as if flying, filled with dreadful demons and nagas protecting the city of Bhogavati (the city of Patala), unimaginably wellbuilt. It was once occupied by Kubera (half brother of Ravana). It was guarded by horrible demons holding tridents and spears in their hands. The city appeared like a cavern protected by venomous serpents with protruding fangs. Hanuman examined the high security of Lanka and looked at the ocean. He thought of the form of Ravana, a formidable enemy:
translations.hindi: केलासशिखरप्रख्येरालिखन्तीसिवाम्बरम्‌' । घधियमाणामिवाकाशमुच्छितेभंवनोत्तम: ।। २३ लंका के उत्तर दिशा का फाटक भी केलास के सदुश ग्राकादा-स्पर्शी था । ऐसा जान पड़ता था, मानों उसके ऊंच-ऊंचे मकान श्राकाश को सहारा देने वाले सम्भे हैँ । ग्रथवा वे ऊंचे मकान को धारण किए हुए हूँ

verses.sloka: संपूर्णां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्नागैर्भोगवतीमिव ।अचिन्त्यां सुकृतां स्पष्टां कुबेराध्युषितां पुरा ॥५-२-२४॥
verses.transliteration: saṁpūrṇāṁ rākṣasairghorairnāgairbhogavatīmiva ।acintyāṁ sukṛtāṁ spaṣṭāṁ kuberādhyuṣitāṁ purā ॥5-2-24॥

translations.english: Observing Lanka that resembled mount Kailas, with sky scrapers appearing as if flying, filled with dreadful demons and nagas protecting the city of Bhogavati (the city of Patala), unimaginably wellbuilt. It was once occupied by Kubera (half brother of Ravana). It was guarded by horrible demons holding tridents and spears in their hands. The city appeared like a cavern protected by venomous serpents with protruding fangs. Hanuman examined the high security of Lanka and looked at the ocean. He thought of the form of Ravana, a formidable enemy:
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी कहने लगे कि, जिस प्रकार भोगवतीपुरी भयंकर नागों से भरी है, उसी प्रकार यह लंका भौ घोर राक्षसो से भरी हुई है

verses.sloka: दंष्ट्रिभिर्बहुभिः शूरैः शूलपट्टिसपाणिभिः ।रक्षितां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्गुहामाशीविषैरिव ॥५-२-२५॥
verses.transliteration: daṁṣṭribhirbahubhiḥ śūraiḥ śūlapaṭṭisapāṇibhiḥ ।rakṣitāṁ rākṣasairghorairguhāmāśīviṣairiva ॥5-2-25॥

translations.english: Observing Lanka that resembled mount Kailas, with sky scrapers appearing as if flying, filled with dreadful demons and nagas protecting the city of Bhogavati (the city of Patala), unimaginably wellbuilt. It was once occupied by Kubera (half brother of Ravana). It was guarded by horrible demons holding tridents and spears in their hands. The city appeared like a cavern protected by venomous serpents with protruding fangs. Hanuman examined the high security of Lanka and looked at the ocean. He thought of the form of Ravana, a formidable enemy:
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने देखा कि, लंका की भली-भाँति रक्षा तो समुद्र ही कर रहा है। साथ ही हनुमानजी ने यह भी सोचा कि, रावण भी एक महा भयंकर शत्रु है

verses.sloka: तस्याश्च महतीं गुप्तिं सागरं च निरीक्ष्य सः ।रावणं च रिपुं घोरं चिन्तयामास वानरः ॥५-२-२६॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāśca mahatīṁ guptiṁ sāgaraṁ ca nirīkṣya saḥ ।rāvaṇaṁ ca ripuṁ ghoraṁ cintayāmāsa vānaraḥ ॥5-2-26॥

translations.english: Observing Lanka that resembled mount Kailas, with sky scrapers appearing as if flying, filled with dreadful demons and nagas protecting the city of Bhogavati (the city of Patala), unimaginably wellbuilt. It was once occupied by Kubera (half brother of Ravana). It was guarded by horrible demons holding tridents and spears in their hands. The city appeared like a cavern protected by venomous serpents with protruding fangs. Hanuman examined the high security of Lanka and looked at the ocean. He thought of the form of Ravana, a formidable enemy:
translations.hindi: आगत्यापीह हरयो भविष्यन्ति निरर्थकाः । न हि युद्धेन वे लंका शक्या जेतुं 'सुरासुरेः ।। २६ यदि वानरगण यहाँ किसी प्रकार झा भी पहुँचे, तो भी उनका यहाँ आना व्यर्थं होगा । क्योंकि इस लंका को जीतने की शक्ति तो देवताओं और दैत्यों में भी नहीं हे

verses.sloka: आगत्यापीह हरयो भविष्यन्ति निररथकाः ।न हि युद्धेन व लङ्का शक्या जेतुं सुरैरपि ॥५-२-२७॥
verses.transliteration: āgatyāpīha harayo bhaviṣyanti nirarathakāḥ ।na hi yuddhena va laṅkā śakyā jetuṁ surairapi ॥5-2-27॥

translations.english: 'It is not possible for monkeys to come here and even if they do, it is no use. Lanka is invincible even to the gods in war.

verses.sloka: इमां तु विषमां दुर्गां लङ्कां रावणपालिताम् ।प्राप्यापि स महाबाहुः किम् करिष्यति राघवः ॥५-२-२८॥
verses.transliteration: imāṁ tu viṣamāṁ durgāṁ laṅkāṁ rāvaṇapālitām ।prāpyāpi sa mahābāhuḥ kim kariṣyati rāghavaḥ ॥5-2-28॥

translations.english: 'What will Rama the mighty armed hero do even after reaching this formidable city of Lanka ruled by Ravana?

verses.sloka: अवकाशो न सान्त्वस्य रक्षसेष्वभिगम्यते ।न दानस्य न भेदस्य नैव युद्धस्य दृश्यते ॥५-२-२९॥
verses.transliteration: avakāśo na sāntvasya rakṣaseṣvabhigamyate ।na dānasya na bhedasya naiva yuddhasya dṛśyate ॥5-2-29॥

translations.english: 'There is no scope for reconciliation with the demons. It is not possible to win over them with gifts. They cannot be divided by dissension. There is no scope for war.

verses.sloka: चतुर्णामेव हि गतिर्वानराणां महात्मनाम् ।वालिपुत्रस्य नीलस्य मम राज्ञश्च धीमतः ॥५-२-३०॥
verses.transliteration: caturṇāmeva hi gatirvānarāṇāṁ mahātmanām ।vāliputrasya nīlasya mama rājñaśca dhīmataḥ ॥5-2-30॥

translations.english: 'Only four great monkeys can have access to this place. They are Angada the son of Vali, Nila, Sugriva, the wise king of monkeys and myself.
translations.hindi: चतुर्णामेव हि गतिर्वानराणां महात्मनास्‌ । बालिपुत्रस्य नीलस्य मस राज्ञश्च धीमतः ॥२&।। हमारी सेना में चार ही ऐसे जन हैं जो यहाँ ग्रा सकते हैं । एक तो अंगद, दूसरे नील, तीसरा में और चौय बुद्धिमान वानरराज सुग्रीव ।! २६।। यावज्जानामि वैदेहीं यदि जोवति वा न वा। तत्रेव चिन्तयिष्यामि दृष्ट्वा तां जनकात्मजास्‌

verses.sloka: यावज्जानामि वैदेहीं यदि जीवति वा न वा ।तत्रैव चिन्तयिष्यामि दृष्ट्वा तां जनकात्मजाम् ॥५-२-३१॥
verses.transliteration: yāvajjānāmi vaidehīṁ yadi jīvati vā na vā ।tatraiva cintayiṣyāmi dṛṣṭvā tāṁ janakātmajām ॥5-2-31॥

translations.english: 'Whether Janaka's daughter, Vaidehi is alive or not is not known. After seeing her I shall think over'.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के हित में रत, कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी पर्वेत के शिखर पर बैठे हुए मुहृतं भर तक मन हो मद कुछ सोचते रहे

verses.sloka: ततः स चिन्तयामास मुहूर्तं कपिकुञ्जरः ।गिरिशृङ्गे स्थितस्तस्मिन् रामस्याभ्युदये रतः ॥५-२-३२॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa muhūrtaṁ kapikuñjaraḥ ।giriśṛṅge sthitastasmin rāmasyābhyudaye rataḥ ॥5-2-32॥

translations.english: Standing on the mountain, the elephant among monkeys pondered for a while on the means of finding Sita, in which lay the welfare of Rama.

verses.sloka: अनेन रूपेण मया न शक्या रक्षसां पुरी ।प्रवेष्टुं राक्षसैर्गुप्ता क्रूरैर्बलसमन्वितैः ॥५-२-३३॥
verses.transliteration: anena rūpeṇa mayā na śakyā rakṣasāṁ purī ।praveṣṭuṁ rākṣasairguptā krūrairbalasamanvitaiḥ ॥5-2-33॥

translations.english: 'I shall not be able in my present form to enter the city guarded by fierce and powerful demons.
translations.hindi: तब मुझे, जानकी जी का पता लगाने के लिए, इन सब महाबली ओर महापराक्रमी राक्षसों को घोखा देना होगा

verses.sloka: उग्रौजसो महावीर्या बलवन्तश्च राक्षसाः ।वञ्चनीया मया सर्वे जानकीं परिमार्गता ॥५-२-३४॥
verses.transliteration: ugraujaso mahāvīryā balavantaśca rākṣasāḥ ।vañcanīyā mayā sarve jānakīṁ parimārgatā ॥5-2-34॥

translations.english: While searching for Janaki, all the demons—fierce, mighty and powerful—must be eluded by me.
translations.hindi: ग्रतः मझे रात के समय ऐसे रूप से जिसे कोई देखे श्रौर कोई न देखे, लंका में घसना उचित है । क्योंकि इतना बड़ा काय बिना ऐसा किए पूरा नहीं होगा

verses.sloka: लक्ष्यालक्ष्येण रूपेण रात्रौ लङ्का पुरी मया ।प्रवेष्टुं प्राप्तकालं मे कृत्यं साधयितुं महत् ॥५-२-३५॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣyālakṣyeṇa rūpeṇa rātrau laṅkā purī mayā ।praveṣṭuṁ prāptakālaṁ me kṛtyaṁ sādhayituṁ mahat ॥5-2-35॥

translations.english: 'To accomplish this great task I will have to assume an inconspicious form and enter the city of Lanka in the night as that is the appropriate time.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार हनुमानजी सुरों और श्रसुरों से दुराधष उस लंकापुरी को बराबर देखने लगे और वार वार लम्बी सांसे ले यह सोचते थे कि, किस उपाय से जनकनन्दिनी जानकी को में देख ल्‌ श्रौर उस दुरात्मा राक्षसराज रावण की दृष्टि से बचा रहूँ

verses.sloka: तां पुरीं तादृशीं दृष्ट्वा दुराधर्शां सुरासुरैः ।हनुमान् चिन्तयामास विनिश्चित्य मुहुर्मुहुः ॥५-२-३६॥
verses.transliteration: tāṁ purīṁ tādṛśīṁ dṛṣṭvā durādharśāṁ surāsuraiḥ ।hanumān cintayāmāsa viniścitya muhurmuhuḥ ॥5-2-36॥

translations.english: 'Looking at the city, unassailable even to gods and demons, Hanuman sighed again and again thinking:
translations.hindi: कत्तंव्याकर्तव्य के विषय में निश्चित कर लेने पर भी, ऐसे दूतों के कारण कार्य की सिद्धि नहीं होती । क्योंकि वे अपनी बृद्धिमानी के अभिमान में चर हो, कार्यों को वना कर, उन्हें बिगाड़ डालते हैं

verses.sloka: केनोपायेन पशेयं मैथिलीं जनकात्मजाम् ।अदृष्टो राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन दुरात्मना ॥५-२-३७॥
verses.transliteration: kenopāyena paśeyaṁ maithilīṁ janakātmajām ।adṛṣṭo rākṣasendreṇa rāvaṇena durātmanā ॥5-2-37॥

translations.english: 'By what means can I find Mythili, daughter of Janaka, without being noticed by the evilminded Ravana, the lord of demons?
translations.hindi: तीनों लोकों में प्रसिद्ध श्रीरामचन्द्रजी का कार्य किस प्रकार करू जिससे कार्य विगड़ने न पावे । में तो श्रकेला एकान्त में जानकी को देखना चाहता हँ

verses.sloka: न विनश्येत्कथं कार्यं रामस्य विदितात्मनः ।एकामेकश्च पश्येयं रहिते जनकात्मजाम् ॥५-२-३८॥
verses.transliteration: na vinaśyetkathaṁ kāryaṁ rāmasya viditātmanaḥ ।ekāmekaśca paśyeyaṁ rahite janakātmajām ॥5-2-38॥

translations.english: 'How can the purpose of Rama, a noble soul be not spoilt? I may have a private audience with the daughter of Janaka.

verses.sloka: भूताश्चार्था विपद्यन्ते देशकालविरोधिताः ।विक्लबं दूतमासाद्य तमः सूर्योदये यथा ॥५-२-३९॥
verses.transliteration: bhūtāścārthā vipadyante deśakālavirodhitāḥ ।viklabaṁ dūtamāsādya tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā ॥5-2-39॥

translations.english: 'Just as darkness disappears at Sunrise, wellplanned strategies also fail at the hands of a thoughtless messenger when they are set in opposition to proper time and place.

verses.sloka: अर्थानर्थान्तरे बुद्धिर्निश्चितापि न शोभते ।घातयन्ति हि कार्याणि दूताः पण्डितमानिनः ॥५-२-४०॥
verses.transliteration: arthānarthāntare buddhirniścitāpi na śobhate ।ghātayanti hi kāryāṇi dūtāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ ॥5-2-40॥

translations.english: 'Even though messengers are not intelligent, they think themselves clever and capable. They act foolishly, swerve from proper course of action and fail in their effort.
translations.hindi: अतः अब किस उपाय से में काम लू जिससे न तो कार्य ही बिगड़े, और न मुझमें कादरता झावे । साथ ही मेरा समुद्र फांदना वृथा भी न हो

verses.sloka: न विनश्येत्कथं कार्यं वैक्लब्यम् न कथं भवेत् ।लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्य कथं नु न वृथा भवेत् ॥५-२-४१॥
verses.transliteration: na vinaśyetkathaṁ kāryaṁ vaiklabyam na kathaṁ bhavet ।laṅghanaṁ ca samudrasya kathaṁ nu na vṛthā bhavet ॥5-2-41॥

translations.english: 'How should the task be performed? How to avoid impetuousness? How can my purpose of crossing the ocean be not wasted?

verses.sloka: मयि दृष्टे तु रक्षोभी रामस्य विदितात्मनः ।भवेद्व्यर्थमिदं कार्यं रावणानर्थमिच्छतः ॥५-२-४२॥
verses.transliteration: mayi dṛṣṭe tu rakṣobhī rāmasya viditātmanaḥ ।bhavedvyarthamidaṁ kāryaṁ rāvaṇānarthamicchataḥ ॥5-2-42॥

translations.english: 'If I am seen by the demons, the plan of Rama, possessor of selfknowledge, to kill Ravana, will be wasted.
translations.hindi: जिभुवन-विख्यात श्रीरामचन्द्रजी रावण को दण्ड देना चाहते हैं, श्रतः यदि राक्षसों ने मुझे देख लिया तो ध्रीरामचन्द्र का यह कार्य बिगड़ जायगा iN Rh स हि शक्यं कदचित्स्थातुसविज्ञातेन राक्षस: । अपि राक्षसरूपेण किमुतान्येन केनचित्‌

verses.sloka: न हि शक्यं क्वचित् स्थातुमविज्ञातेन राक्षसैः ।अपि राक्षसरूपेण किमुतान्येन केनचित् ॥५-२-४३॥
verses.transliteration: na hi śakyaṁ kvacit sthātumavijñātena rākṣasaiḥ ।api rākṣasarūpeṇa kimutānyena kenacit ॥5-2-43॥

translations.english: 'It is difficult to stay with the demon anywhere here even in the disguise of a demon without being identified. It will not be possible to remain unidentified even by assuming any other form.

verses.sloka: वायुरप्यत्र नाज्ञातश्चरेदिति मतिर्मम ।न ह्यस्त्यविदितं किंचिद्राक्षसानां बलीयसाम् ॥५-२-४४॥
verses.transliteration: vāyurapyatra nājñātaścarediti matirmama ।na hyastyaviditaṁ kiṁcidrākṣasānāṁ balīyasām ॥5-2-44॥

translations.english: 'I think even the wind who has no form cannot move here without being detected. Nothing escapes the notice of powerful demons. There is nothing unknown to them.
translations.hindi: यदि मैं भ्रपने प्रसली रूप में यहां ठहरा रहे तो केवल स्वामी का कायं ही नष्ट न होगा, बल्कि में भी मारा जाऊंगा

verses.sloka: इहाहं यदि तिष्ठामि स्वेन रूपेण संवृतः ।विनाशमुपयास्यामि भर्तुरर्थश्च हीयते ॥५-२-४५॥
verses.transliteration: ihāhaṁ yadi tiṣṭhāmi svena rūpeṇa saṁvṛtaḥ ।vināśamupayāsyāmi bharturarthaśca hīyate ॥5-2-45॥

translations.english: 'I will surely meet with death if I hide here in my original form and my master's mission also will be spoilt.

verses.sloka: तदहं स्वेन रूपेण रजन्यां ह्रस्वतां गतः ।लङ्कामभिपतिष्यामि राघवस्यार्थसिद्धये ॥५-२-४६॥
verses.transliteration: tadahaṁ svena rūpeṇa rajanyāṁ hrasvatāṁ gataḥ ।laṅkāmabhipatiṣyāmi rāghavasyārthasiddhaye ॥5-2-46॥

translations.english: 'Therefore I shall transform myself into a tiny form and jump about the city of Lanka during night time in order to accomplish Raghava's purpose.

verses.sloka: रावणस्य पुरीं रात्रौ प्रविश्य सुदुरासदाम् ।विचिन्वन् भवनं स्र्वं द्रक्ष्यामि जनकात्मजाम् ॥५-२-४७॥
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya purīṁ rātrau praviśya sudurāsadām ।vicinvan bhavanaṁ srvaṁ drakṣyāmi janakātmajām ॥5-2-47॥

translations.english: 'Entering by night the inaccessible city of Ravana, I shall search all over the palace and find Sita'.

verses.sloka: इति संचिन्त्य हनुमान् सूर्यस्यास्तमयं कपिः ।आचकांक्षे ततो वीरो वैदेह्या द्रशनोतुसकः ॥५-२-४८॥
verses.transliteration: iti saṁcintya hanumān sūryasyāstamayaṁ kapiḥ ।ācakāṁkṣe tato vīro vaidehyā draśanotusakaḥ ॥5-2-48॥

translations.english: Having planned in that manner the heroic Hanuman keen to see Sita waited for the Sunset.
translations.hindi: फ्ाठात्तरे--हीयते । २ पाठाम्तरे--'लंकामधिपतिष्यानि । ७ पाठान्तरे--“सङ्वित्य ।” ४ वुष्दंधकमाव:--विढयप्रमाण: (द्रो०) ५२ क ह सुन्दरकाण्डे जब सूर्य भ्रस्ताचलगामी हुए, तब रात में हनुमानजी ने श्रपने शरीर को बिल्ली के समान छोटा प्रौर देखने में विस्मयोत्पादक बनाया

verses.sloka: सूर्ये चास्तं गते रात्रौ देहं संक्षिप्य मारुतिः ।वृषदंशकमात्रः सन् बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः ॥५-२-४९॥
verses.transliteration: sūrye cāstaṁ gate rātrau dehaṁ saṁkṣipya mārutiḥ ।vṛṣadaṁśakamātraḥ san babhūvādbhutadarśanaḥ ॥5-2-49॥

translations.english: When Sun set, Maruti, the son of the Windgod, reduced himself at night to the small size of a cat, wonderful to behold.

verses.sloka: प्रदोषकाले हनुमांस्तूर्णमुत्प्लुत्य वीर्यवान् ।प्रविवेश पुरीं रम्यां सुविभक्तमहापथाम् ॥५-२-५०॥
verses.transliteration: pradoṣakāle hanumāṁstūrṇamutplutya vīryavān ।praviveśa purīṁ ramyāṁ suvibhaktamahāpathām ॥5-2-50॥

translations.english: As soon as dusk had set in, courageous Hanuman jumped in and entered the well laidout royal path of the beautiful city.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने लंका के भीतर जाकर देखा कि, बड़े बड़े भवनों की श्रेणियों से श्रौर अनेक सुवर्णमय खम्भो से तथा सोने के झरोखों से लंकापुरी गन्धवंनगरी की तरह सजी हुई है

verses.sloka: प्रासादमालाविततां स्तम्भैः काञ्चनराजतैः ।शातकुम्भमयैर्जालैर्गन्धर्वनगरोपमाम् ॥५-२-५१॥
verses.transliteration: prāsādamālāvitatāṁ stambhaiḥ kāñcanarājataiḥ ।śātakumbhamayairjālairgandharvanagaropamām ॥5-2-51॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the city stretched with rows of buildings all over,with seven or eight storied mansions, which had pillars of gold and silver, windows with fretwork of gold, inlaid with crystals, floors decorated with gold, resembling the grand city of gandharvas.
translations.hindi: सत-प्रठ-खने-भवनो से और स्फटिक खचित तथा सुवर्ण भूषित अनेक स्थानों से वह राक्षसों की निवास-स्थली लंकापुरी अत्यन्त शोभायुक्त देख पड़ती थी

verses.sloka: सप्तभौमाष्टभौमैश्च स ददर्श महापुरीम् ।तलैः स्फतिकसंकीर्णैः कार्तस्वरविभूषितैः ॥५-२-५२॥
verses.transliteration: saptabhaumāṣṭabhaumaiśca sa dadarśa mahāpurīm ।talaiḥ sphatikasaṁkīrṇaiḥ kārtasvaravibhūṣitaiḥ ॥5-2-52॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the city stretched with rows of buildings all over,with seven or eight storied mansions, which had pillars of gold and silver, windows with fretwork of gold, inlaid with crystals, floors decorated with gold, resembling the grand city of gandharvas.
translations.hindi: राक्षसों के घरों के फर्श वड्ये मणियों के जड़ावों श्रौर मोतियों की झालरों से शोभित थे

verses.sloka: वैडूर्यमणिचित्रैश्च मुक्ताजालविभूषितैः ।तलैः शुशुभिरे तानि भवनान्यत्र रक्षसाम् ॥५-२-५३॥
verses.transliteration: vaiḍūryamaṇicitraiśca muktājālavibhūṣitaiḥ ।talaiḥ śuśubhire tāni bhavanānyatra rakṣasām ॥5-2-53॥

translations.english: Inlaid with precious gems and fretwork, and ornamented with pearls, the mansions of demons looked splendid.
translations.hindi: राक्षसों के घर के तोरणद्वार, जो सुवर्णनिमित और रंग-विरंगे बने हुए थे, चारों ओर से विभूषित थे और लंकापुरी की शोभा बढ़ा रहे थे

verses.sloka: काञ्चनानि च चित्राणि तोरणानि च रक्षसाम् ।लङ्कामुद्द्योतयामासुः सर्वतः समलंकृताम् ॥५-२-५४॥
verses.transliteration: kāñcanāni ca citrāṇi toraṇāni ca rakṣasām ।laṅkāmuddyotayāmāsuḥ sarvataḥ samalaṁkṛtām ॥5-2-54॥

translations.english: The golden archways of the demon were colourful. They illuminated the well decorated Lanka from all sides.
translations.hindi: जानकी जी के दर्शन के लिए उत्सुक, महाकपि हनुमान जी इस प्रकार की अचिन्त्य श्रौर आश्चयंजनक बनावट की लंक्रापुरी को देख, पहिले तो हषिंत हुए, फिर पीछे उदास हो गए

verses.sloka: अचिन्त्यामद्भुताकारां दृष्ट्वा लङ्कां महाकपिः ।आसीद्विष्ण्डो हृष्टश्च वैदेह्या दर्शनोत्सुकः ॥५-२-५५॥
verses.transliteration: acintyāmadbhutākārāṁ dṛṣṭvā laṅkāṁ mahākapiḥ ।āsīdviṣṇḍo hṛṣṭaśca vaidehyā darśanotsukaḥ ॥5-2-55॥

translations.english: Beholding Lanka of unimaginable, wonderful glory, the great monkey keen to see Sita became sad as well as elated at once (He did not know how to find Sita in that city and felt sad. But he was also elated that he was going to meet her at any cost.)
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने देखा कि, रावण द्वारा रक्षित, प्रसिद्ध लंकानगरी, श्रेणीबद्ध सफेद श्रट्टालिकाग्रों से, महामूल्यवान्‌ सुवणंमय झरोखों श्रौर तोरणद्वारों से भ्रलंकृत है और अत्यन्त बलिष्ट राक्षसों की सेना चारों ओर से उसकी रखवाली कर रही है

verses.sloka: स पाण्डुराविद्धविमानमालिनीं ।महार्हजाम्बूनदजालतोरणाम् ।यशस्विनीं रावणबाहुपालितां ।क्षपाचरैर्भिमबलैः समावृताम् ॥५-२-५६॥
verses.transliteration: sa pāṇḍurāviddhavimānamālinīṁ ।mahārhajāmbūnadajālatoraṇām ।yaśasvinīṁ rāvaṇabāhupālitāṁ ।kṣapācarairbhimabalaiḥ samāvṛtām ॥5-2-56॥

translations.english: He found that famed place with a garland of tall, white mansions, conspicuous with archways latticed with gold strings, protected by mighty Ravana and surrounded by terrific demons.
translations.hindi: उस समय मानों वायुपुत्र की सहायता करने के लिए सहस्नों किरणों वाला चन्द्रमा, तारांग्रों के साथ, चाँदनी छिटकाता हुश्रा, श्राकाश में श्रा विराजा

verses.sloka: चन्द्रोऽपि साचिव्यमिवास्य कुर्वं ।स्तारागणैर्मध्यगतो विराजन् ।ज्योत्स्नावितानेन वितत्य लोक ।मुत्तिष्ठते नैकसहस्ररश्मिः ॥५-२-५७॥
verses.transliteration: candro'pi sācivyamivāsya kurvaṁ ।stārāgaṇairmadhyagato virājan ।jyotsnāvitānena vitatya loka ।muttiṣṭhate naikasahasraraśmiḥ ॥5-2-57॥

translations.english: Even the Moon rose with thousands of rays in the centre of multitudes of stars overspreading and illumining the world with a canopy of bright beams, as if to render ministerial help to Hanuman.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे--“पाण्ड्रोद्विद्ध ।” २ पाठान्तरे--“हरिप्रवीरः ।” शड सुन्दरकाण्डे कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमान जी ने देखा कि, सरोवर में जिस प्रकार हंस उछल कूद मचाते हें, उसी प्रकार दूष अथवा मृणाल वर्ण शङ्ख की तरह चन्द्रमा भी प्राकाश में उदय होकर ऊपर को उठ रहा है

verses.sloka: शङ्खप्रभं क्षीरमृणालवर्ण ।मुद्गच्छमानं व्यवभासमानम् ।ददर्श चन्द्रं स हरिप्रवीरः ।प्लोप्लूयमानं सरसीव हंसम् ॥५-२-५८॥
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhaprabhaṁ kṣīramṛṇālavarṇa ।mudgacchamānaṁ vyavabhāsamānam ।dadarśa candraṁ sa haripravīraḥ ।ploplūyamānaṁ sarasīva haṁsam ॥5-2-58॥

translations.english: The heroic vanara saw the rising Moon flitting in and out shining like a fresh white conch, in the colour of milk and lotus stalks, bright like a swan floating in the lakelike sky. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्वितीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the second sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
